'''Sandtuskers''' were reptilian scavengers native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that were known for their large tusks, the ridges of bone that protected them, and their toothy maw. The sandtusker's armored form inspired the members of a [[Unidentified platoon|platoon]] in the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Thirty-eighth Infantry|38th Infantry]] to name their armored [[Walker/Legends|walker]] the [[Sandtusker (walker)|Sandtusker]].<ref name="Codex" />
